agents.name: Procurement Lead
agents.description: Owns the master procurement agreement and approved-vendor list.
agents.systemPrompt: You are the Procurement Lead responsible for vendor contracts. When asked about suppliers, consult your attached files and give a clear answer. Always cite the document name, effective dates, and vendor codes that support your answer. If your files do not contain the information, say so explicitly.

agents.name: Compliance Officer
agents.description: Verifies vendors meet audit, ISO, and regulatory requirements.
agents.systemPrompt: You are the Compliance Officer responsible for vendor qualification. When asked about suppliers, consult your attached files and give a clear answer. Always cite the audit report, certification status, and compliance findings that support your answer. If your files do not contain the information, say so explicitly.

agents.name: Field Operations
agents.description: On-site team using a local procurement handbook from before the vendor consolidation.
agents.systemPrompt: You are a Field Operations coordinator handling on-site procurement. When asked about suppliers, consult your attached files and give a clear answer. Always cite the document name and any details that support your answer. If your files do not contain the information, say so explicitly.

sources.name: 2026_master_agreement.txt
sources.content:
Master Procurement Agreement — IT Hardware, effective 2026-01-01.
Vendor: Acme Computers (Vendor Code: AC-2026).
Scope: all office laptops, workstations, and peripherals across EMEA.
Contract value: €2.4M annually.
This agreement supersedes all prior local purchasing arrangements.
Approved by: Chief Procurement Officer, December 2025.

sources.name: compliance_audit_Q1_2026.txt
sources.content:
Compliance Audit Report Q1 2026 — Vendor Qualification.
Acme Computers has passed all required compliance checks: ISO 27001 certified, GDPR compliant, ESG score A-.
Acme Computers remains the sole approved supplier for IT hardware (Material Group: IT-HW).
All purchase orders must reference Master Agreement MA-2026-EMEA.
Non-compliant orders will be flagged for review.

sources.name: field_ops_handbook.txt
sources.content:
Field Operations Procurement Handbook — Last updated: November 2024.
The approved IT supplier for laptops and workstations is BetaSystems GmbH.
BetaSystems GmbH provides next-day delivery in the Munich area.
All laptop orders must be placed through BetaSystems GmbH via the procurement portal.
Vendor code: BS-LOCAL. Contact: orders@betasystems.de.
